answers.core: It could be made as an add-on, *but* it's too slow to be worth the effort. I'm not sure if this can be alleviated with Vulkan. See [godot-dynamic-resolution-demo](https://github.com/Calinou/godot-dynamic-resolution-demo) where I attempted this in 3.2.1. The viewport creation costs made it slower than not using dynamic resolution in the first place :slightly_frowning_face:
answers.workaround: Not really, as it takes a fair amount of effort to do it right. See also the performance issues described below.
